subject: [PATCH v5 06/19] selftests/mm: stop khugepaged during the MADV_COLLAPSE cases

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file to stop khugepaged during MADV_COLLAPSE cases by clearing per-order controls in addition to global controls. This is necessary because khugepaged was interfering with the test cases, causing them to fail due to unexpected page collapses. The patch sets the per-order controls to 'inherit' instead of 'never', allowing MADV_COLLAPSE on shmem to still find an order to build pages. This change fixes a problem introduced by a previous patch and ensures that the test cases run correctly.

reviews.author: Baolin Wang
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Baolin Wang pointed out that the patch description incorrectly identifies the commit that introduced the khugepaged issue, suggesting that b7f16963efe7 is the correct fix tag because it changed khugepaged's behavior for all orders, not just PMD order.

Reviewer Baolin Wang suggested that the patch is a workaround and proposed fixing the issue in the shmem code instead, providing a specific diff to modify the mm/shmem.c file.
reviews.raw_body:
Right. So I think the correct fix tag is b7f16963efe7 ("mm/khugepaged: 
run khugepaged for all orders"), because before this commit, khugepaged 
would not try to collapse this range since it only checked whether the 
PMD order was suitable for collapse.

---

This looks like a workaround to me. Shouldn't we fix this in shmem 
instead? Since MADV_COLLAPSE is supposed to ignore the THP setting, the 
fix should be something like this?

diff --git a/mm/shmem.c b/mm/shmem.c
index c92ed17dbc4a..e0c0901c34a4 100644
--- a/mm/shmem.c
+++ b/mm/shmem.c
@@ -2050,7 +2050,7 @@ unsigned long shmem_allowable_huge_orders(struct 
inode *inode,
         global_orders = shmem_huge_global_enabled(inode, index, write_end,
                                                   shmem_huge_force, 
vma, vm_flags);
         /* Tmpfs huge pages allocation */
-       if (!vma || !vma_is_anon_shmem(vma))
+       if (!vma || !vma_is_anon_shmem(vma) || shmem_huge_force)
                 return global_orders;

         /*

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (author)
reviews.summary:

Author acknowledges that clearing per-order controls is a separate issue and suggests creating a follow-up patch to address it, leaving the current selftest update as-is.
reviews.raw_body:
Agreed.  The series is in mm-new already; if a respin is needed I will use
that tag.

---

Good point.

It can be a follow-up patch.  Do you want to make a proper shmem.c fix
and update the selftest along with it?

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file to stop khugepaged from interfering with MADV_COLLAPSE cases by clearing per-order controls in addition to global controls. The problem it solves is that khugepaged was collapsing the range being tested, causing test failures. The approach taken is to set the per-order controls to 'inherit' instead of 'never', allowing MADV_COLLAPSE on shmem to still find an order to build.
